title: Scully says Dr. G is no longer available

tellings.quote: And Scully says, "Oh, that won't be possible. Uh, we uh what was the He's no longer available."

plain: In 1950, the writer Frank Scully was asked to bring forward a scientist he called Dr. G, and he answered, "Oh, that won't be possible... He's no longer available." A researcher named Scott Ramsey tells this as happening around a Chicago radio station, and links the story to a physicist named John Torrance Tate. Ramsey raises it because it suggests the scientist behind Scully's crashed-saucer claims was being kept out of sight.
